name: metamodel.addRelationKind
title: Add relation kind
summary: Add a relation kind to the metamodel; only the metamodel file that gets it changes, line by line.
details: The relation kind is added at the end of `relations` in the first metamodel file by name that has the list, else at the end of the first file, where the list is created (SR-236 AK4). Every other line of the file stays as it was, with its comment and line ending (SR-236 AK3); no element file changes and nothing in Git (D-036). Without `key`, the key is made from the name: lower case, the German umlauts and sharp s as ae, oe, ue and ss, every run of other characters one hyphen (SR-236 AK6); it is fixed afterwards (D-043). Relations of the new kind can be set at once (SR-239 AK1, SR-067). The metamodel files are read again before the change, and the metamodel afterwards is checked as a read would check it: an error refuses the command, warnings are in `problems` (SR-236 AK1). The next command of the same process uses the new metamodel (SR-236 AK9). Errors: input.invalid with details.reason key-required when no key is given and the one made from the name is empty, does not start with a letter, is longer than 64 characters or is already the key of a property or relation kind (details.key); input.invalid with details.reason taken when another relation kind has the name, in Unicode normal form NFC (details.field, details.relationKind); input.invalid with details.reason metamodel-invalid and the errors in details.problems when the metamodel would have an error (such as a key that is already defined, an unknown type or two limits for the same pair of types); workspace.read-only when the metamodel files do not give a valid metamodel or the metamodel repository is not on this machine; input.invalid with details.reason git-folder when the metamodel folder is .git or a repository of its own (D-036); file.read-only when the metamodel repository cannot be written (SR-018 AK2); file.faulty when the list `relations` of the file is an alias or has an anchor (details.repository, details.file, details.line) or is no list; file.changed-on-disk when another process changed the file since it was read (SR-236 AK10). Nothing is written on these.
whileReadOnlyReason: SR-236 AK5: a metamodel that cannot be read is never changed (SR-011 AK3).

name.description: Display name of the relation kind; no other relation kind may have it.

key.description: Fixed key of the relation kind (D-043), under which element files hold its relations; no property or other relation kind may have it. Left out: made from the name (SR-236 AK6).

inverseName.description: Name shown at the target, such as Derived by (`inverse-name`).

description.description: What the relation kind means, for people.

sourceTypes.description: Keys of the types whose elements may be the source (`source-types`); a type also allows the types that extend it (SR-012 AK2). Left out: every type.

targetTypes.description: Keys of the types whose elements may be the target (`target-types`); a type also allows the types that extend it (SR-012 AK2). Left out: every type.

limits.description: Minimum and maximum number of relations per target type, written as in the metamodel file (SR-152). Left out: any number.

meaning.description: Built-in meaning of the relation kind (D-012), one of `relationMeaning` of metamodel.schema.json.

relationKind.title: Relation kind
relationKind.description: The definition as written to the file.

items.description: Written file, relative to the workspace root.

versionsChanged.title: Versions changed
versionsChanged.description: Elements whose version is another under the new metamodel (SR-015 AK4). A relation kind is no definition the version is computed from (ADR-0005), so this is 0; those of `versionsChangedElements`.

missingRequired.title: Missing required properties
missingRequired.description: Elements that now miss a value of a required property they did not miss before (SR-015 AK3); those of `missingRequiredElements`.

versionsChangedElements.title: Elements with another version
versionsChangedElements.description: The elements `versionsChanged` counts, in store order.

missingRequiredElements.title: Elements missing a required property
missingRequiredElements.description: The elements `missingRequired` counts, in store order.

problems.title: Problems
problems.description: The warnings of the metamodel afterwards (SR-236 AK1).
